title: MONSTER V6 Step 1 — Content-Addressed Proof Reuse
scope: Add a fail-closed content-addressed proof reuse engine so unchanged static artifacts and dependencies can reuse a prior successful terminal proof across unrelated head movement. Production/live-state proof is never reusable. Step 2A and scope-aware mutation leases remain mandatory.
proof_policy: Focused self-test and permanent-contract on exact PR head, then one authoritative DevSystem PR proof, exact-head merge, one merged-main proof, terminal receipt, frozen-registry checkpoint, lease release.
